jobs.title: Manager, Customer Strategy & Operations

Kevin’s ABA operations, intake, training, systems, and family/client coordination experience map closely.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY · Multi-site ambulatory operations

jobs.title: Partnerships Operations Manager

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager

jobs.title: Manager Business Operations – Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement Service

jobs.gap: The service-line environment may favor deeper hospital operations and orthopedic practice experience. Kevin should emphasize transferable patient-service, staffing, training, and systems/process ownership.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations
jobs.why: Good business-operations fit for cross-functional planning, process improvement, structured execution, and operating-rhythm ownership. Kevin’s systems/project work and operational coordination translate well beyond healthcare.
jobs.gap: Senior-manager scope may require broader strategic planning and people leadership than Kevin has formally held. He should focus on end-to-end project ownership, stakeholder management, and measurable workflow improvements.

jobs.title: Senior Manager – Channel Expansion & Operations
jobs.why: Strong growth-operations option with cross-functional execution, channel/process scaling, operational rigor, and data-informed decision making. Kevin’s marketing background plus CRM, automation, reporting, and operations experience create a credible bridge.
jobs.gap: American Express may expect deeper enterprise channel strategy and commercial leadership. Kevin should center workflow systems, growth enablement, reporting, and stakeholder execution rather than SEO.

jobs.title: Principal Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong thematic match for strategic initiatives, process optimization, cross-functional alignment, and operational systems. The remote setup and focus on scalable execution make it a worthwhile stretch application.
jobs.gap: Principal-level scope is the main risk and likely requires deeper senior strategic leadership. Kevin should apply only with a tightly positioned systems-operations résumé and quantified examples of organization-wide impact.
